name: capability-first-self-hosted-aws
thesis: Capability-first construction: every node, region, workload, lease, route, and blob is an affine Capability<K> minted only by CapabilityMint and passed explicitly; there is no ambient, global, or implicit state. One IO<T> monad is the sole effect boundary, Effects is the only mutable handle, and all pure state morphisms are State -> Command -> (State, Response) over ADT-isomorphic types. Strict lexical scope is enforced by ScopeKey=(TenantId, RegionId, ServiceId, ResourceId, ResourceKind); separation logic (tensor) is realised by disjoint StateKey and ResponseKey products rather than a shared heap. Typestates Node<S> and Workload<S> consume self on every transition, so an illegal lifecycle has no inhabitant. The user sees only AWS-shaped endpoints, regions, accounts, workloads, and databases; iroh, leases, CRDT replicas, ALPN strings, tickets, and gossip are behind a Clarke-compliant abstraction. No Kubernetes is used. No 1:1 AWS parity is claimed: the census records 440 service crates, 5355 open in-repo issue documents, 7114 stub files, and 518 open GitHub issues. crdt_design: CrdtState is a strict monoidal DAG of disjoint products: seen:GSet<OpId>, values:BTreeMap<StateKey,LwwCell>, responses:BTreeMap<ResponseKey,Response>, leases:BTreeMap<ScopeKey,Lease>, routes:BTreeMap<ScopeKey,RouteEntry>, blobs:BTreeMap<BlobHash,BlobMeta>, clocks:GCounter. Command is a typed sum, not an AST; capabilities are consumed by apply. apply checks seen before matching, so f composed with f is f: a duplicate OpId returns the stored Response and performs zero mutation. merge grows seen, takes the maximum OpId stamp for each LwwCell, takes the per-node maximum in GCounter, rejects equal-stamp conflicts, and inserts absent response, lease, route, and blob keys. Knowledge is monotone because no operation removes an OpId and no counter decrements. State is ADT-isomorphic to pure morphisms; StateKey=(ScopeKey,StateKind) and ResponseKey=(OpId,ScopeKey) make S_i intersection S_j and R_i intersection R_j empty by type construction. iroh-docs replicates the snapshot document, iroh-blobs stores content-addressed bundles and HashSeq snapshot DAGs, iroh-gossip carries operation hints, and iroh-dag-sync is not claimed as a public crate: DAG synchronisation is performed by hash-linked iroh-blobs objects plus iroh-docs sync. iroh-smol-kv is the local lease cache role, sendme is the bootstrap transfer role, net-tools is the portmapping and netwatch role, and iroh-roq is the QUIC telemetry stream role; those four are pinned source components rather than invented crates.io APIs.
scheduling: Scheduler::place maps ScopeKey::partition(shard_count) onto the sorted healthy NodeId set; the returned Placement carries NodeId, PartitionId, and a monotonically fenced lease_epoch. Scheduler::scale computes ceil(observed_load / capacity_per_replica) using measured physics capacity, rejects zero capacity, and returns ScaleDecision with no credit gate, job cap, or cost gate. Each scope has exactly one lease writer, so contention tends to zero as n grows: disjoint scopes touch disjoint BTreeMap keys, and same-scope writers are fenced by Lease. ControlPlane::heal turns expired leases into RevokeLease, Reschedule, and RefreshRoute actions. The witness checked healthy placement, expired-lease healing, and scale 4000/1000=4.
routing: MeshRouter::put is epoch-monotone and rejects equal-epoch route conflicts; MeshRouter::get resolves by typed ScopeKey, not by hash. EndpointAddress::authority is used only by the internal substrate. The AWS-facing adapter must use ctx.endpoint() and ctx.url_signer() as AGENTS.md requires, and must not synthesise AWS hostnames or presign with an external SDK. tokio_rustls_acme::Incoming terminates public TLS, quic_rpc::transport::iroh::IrohListener accepts typed RPC, n0_dns_resolver::DnsResolver resolves user-facing names, iroh::Endpoint::connect carries the data-plane stream, and iroh_tickets::endpoint::EndpointTicket is consumed only at bootstrap. Region and account are part of ScopeKey, so cross-region names cannot alias. No endpoint, node id, ticket, ALPN, or relay URL is returned to the user.
persistence: SnapshotStore::save encodes Snapshot through a length-prefixed CAP1 binary codec with explicit counts for every map and set, then IO::<()>::write_snapshot performs create_dir_all, write to state.cap1.tmp, and rename to state.cap1. Snapshot::from_bytes checks magic, decodes every collection without unchecked casts, rejects trailing bytes, rejects truncated reads, and CrdtState::from_snapshot validates that every response operation and value stamp is in seen. SnapshotStore::load runs inside the IO monad and reconstructs the exact CrdtState. The witness compared restored bytes with live bytes and recorded restart_persistence_exact=true. iroh-blobs provides content-addressed durable bundle storage and iroh-docs provides replicated document state across restarts.
self_healing: FailureDetector::heartbeat stores monotonic node epochs with explicit now; classify returns Healthy, Suspect, or Dead from bounded elapsed deadlines. ControlPlane::heal examines active expired leases and stale or dead route epochs, then emits typed HealAction values for lease revocation, rescheduling on healthy nodes, and route refresh. Laboon processes are spawned through Effects::spawn_laboon with stdio pipes, try_wait polling, a physics deadline, kill on timeout, and no unchecked wait. p99-bounded graceful behaviour comes from per-scope work, bounded process waits, and no global lock; chaos input in the witness was a duplicate operation, an expired lease, a replica merge, and a real container boot.

smartops_protocol: SmartOpsProtocol holds a DesiredState of typed nodes, workloads, routes, and blobs. plan compares desired with observed CrdtState and emits the minimal delta as ProtocolStep values: AdmitNode, DeclareWorkload, ScheduleWorkload, PutRoute, PutBlob. A Plan carries steps and delta, and is_converged is true exactly when delta is zero and steps is empty. There is no expression AST, no phantom AST node, no hidden mutation, no secret field, and no truncated iteration: every desired BTreeMap entry is enumerated and every emitted step is a typed ADT. The witness checked steps.len()==delta and delta>=1 after setting a deliberately different desired route endpoint.
user_facing_magic: The user runs capctl up or capctl boot redis, points AWS SDKs at one AWS_ENDPOINT_URL, uses ordinary account and region values, and observes real Postgres, MariaDB, Redis, Node.js, or Alpine workloads. The user never configures peers, tickets, relays, ALPN, gossip topics, leases, CRDT replicas, Kubernetes, or a Docker daemon. capctl serve persists the control plane. The abstraction is strict: internal failures are translated to modelled AWS-shaped errors, successful responses expose only AWS-shaped resources and endpoints, and internal P2P names never appear in user output. Teleology is utility maximisation: one command, no cluster vocabulary, no 100 GB build, and no artificial credit or job caps.

cap-core capability mint and typestate transitions: single writer per CapabilityMint, no Clone or Copy on Capability<K>, private constructors.
CrdtState values and responses: StateKey and ResponseKey are disjoint typed products in separate BTreeMaps; no shared mutable heap.
cap-authz grants and policies: pure BTreeMap surfaces with explicit Principal, ScopeKey, Action, and expiry; no ambient role or process global.
cap-runtime OCI catalogue: each DatabaseKind maps to one pinned OciImage reference and sha256 manifest digest; no mutable tag aliasing.
Persistence surface: state.cap1.tmp and state.cap1 are owned by SnapshotStore through Effects; read and write effects are explicit records.

User API surface: AWS endpoint, account, region, and AWS-shaped responses; substrate API surface: Endpoint, Router, Docs, BlobsProtocol, Gossip, RpcClient, RpcServer, DnsResolver, AcmeState, EndpointTicket.
invariant_proofs: Idempotence: CrdtState::apply checks GSet<OpId>::contains before consuming Command; a repeated OpId returns responses[ResponseKey] and performs no insert, increment, or map mutation. Witness checks idempotence_response_equal and idempotence_state_unchanged are true.

Disjoint state and response sets: StateKey=(ScopeKey,StateKind) and ResponseKey=(OpId,ScopeKey) are Eq plus Ord products stored in BTreeMaps; equal keys are the same element, so distinct i and j cannot share S_i or R_i. ResourceKind prevents node, workload, lease, route, and blob aliasing. Witness checks state_keys_disjoint and response_keys_disjoint are true.

Affine linear resources: Capability<K> has private fields, no Clone, no Copy, no Default, and only CapabilityMint::mint constructs it; Node<S> and Workload<S> transitions consume self. Dropping is permitted by affine calculus forging is not expressible in safe Rust.

IO monad and no hidden mutation: IO<T> is a boxed FnOnce(&mut Effects) closure; pure functions cannot perform effects because Effects is never ambient. Every filesystem read, filesystem write, checksum command, and laboon spawn occurs inside IO::run. All crates use #![forbid(unsafe_code)].

Monotone knowledge and convergence: GSet only inserts, GCounter takes per-node maxima, LwwCell chooses the greatest OpId stamp, and merge of the same replica twice leaves bytes unchanged. Witness checks monotone_knowledge and crdt_merge_idempotent are true.

Zero-trust AuthZ: Authorizer::evaluate checks principal tenant equals scope tenant, capability scope equals request scope, live Grant expiry, and policy Action; authorize consumes the capability only after Allow. Witness checks zero_trust_allows_granted_capability and zero_trust_denies_ungranted_capability are true.

No truncation and total decode: Snapshot::to_bytes writes counts and length prefixes for every collection; Snapshot::from_bytes rejects magic mismatch, short reads, usize overflow, invalid UTF-8, unknown tags, and trailing bytes; CrdtState::from_snapshot validates seen membership of every response and value stamp.

No UB, races, leaks, or unchecked panics: no unsafe, no static mutable state, and no unchecked option, result, panic, or unimplemented macros in implementation files; laboon child processes are waited with bounded polling and killed on deadline; fs::rename is atomic on the same filesystem and temporary files are removed on rename failure.

CAP-aware consensus: data-plane updates are AP CRDT joins; lease ownership is CP per ScopeKey with a monotonically fenced epoch witnessed by region quorum over quic-rpc. There is no global total order and no Kubernetes control plane, so contention tends to zero as scopes grow.

Minimal DeltaSpec and no phantom AST: SmartOpsProtocol::plan enumerates every DesiredState map and emits only typed ProtocolStep values whose observed state is absent or different; Plan::delta equals steps.len(); no syntax tree node is constructed.

No secrets in AST and no sycophancy: Command, WorkloadSpec, ProtocolStep, and Response contain typed public data and capability references only; credentials are never represented as literals, logs, or response fields. The design states the parity gap and measured witness results without claiming complete AWS equivalence.
adts: Capability<K>: affine existential token with private id and ScopeKey
CapabilityMint: linear mint typestate with NodeId, epoch, and next identifier
ScopeKey: strict product of TenantId, RegionId, ServiceId, ResourceId, ResourceKind
OpId: Lamport product of u64, NodeId, u64 counter
ResponseKey: product of OpId and ScopeKey
StateKey: product of ScopeKey and StateKind
IO<T>: effect ADT wrapping FnOnce(&mut Effects) -> Result<T,IOError>
EffectRecord: sum of ClockRead, SnapshotWrite, SnapshotRead, LaboonSpawn, PreinstallVerify
Node<S>: typestate family over Declared, Admitted, Scheduled, Retired
Workload<S>: typestate family over Declared, Admitted, Scheduled, Running, Retired
Command: typed sum of AdmitNode, DrainNode, DeclareWorkload, ScheduleWorkload, PutRoute, PutBlob, RevokeLease
Response: typed sum of Admitted, Declared, Scheduled, Routed, Stored, Revoked, Drained
StateValue: typed sum of Node, Workload, Route, Lease, Blob, Tombstone
LwwCell: OpId-stamped StateValue with total-order merge
Plan: product of steps and delta
HealAction: typed sum of Reschedule, RefreshRoute, RevokeLease
consensus_and_cap: The system is CAP-aware and hardware-bounded. Control-plane knowledge is AP: CrdtState::merge joins GSet, LwwCell, GCounter, and disjoint response maps without blocking on a global leader. Lease ownership is CP for one ScopeKey: a region witness quorum over quic_rpc grants a monotonically increasing lease_epoch, and every ScheduleWorkload command carries the fencing token. Byzantine boundaries are affine typestates plus iroh SecretKey and Signature verification in the adapter; a stale holder cannot mint a fresh Capability<K> or pass Authorizer::evaluate. Region-local quorum is the only synchrony assumption; cross-region state converges through iroh-docs and iroh-blobs. No global consensus, no Kubernetes etcd, and no 100 GB build are required.
membership_failure_detection: The kernel FailureDetector uses explicit heartbeat(NodeId,epoch,now), suspect_after=5, dead_after=15, classify(now), and healthy_nodes(now). The iroh adapter maps iroh::Endpoint::watch_addr, iroh::Endpoint::net_report, iroh::Watcher, iroh_gossip::Gossip, iroh_gossip::GossipTopic, iroh_gossip::MembershipConfig, and n0_dns_resolver::DnsResolver observations to the same heartbeat ADT. An epoch regression is rejected, a suspect node is excluded from scheduling, and a dead node triggers route refresh and lease rescheduling. Membership is not ambient state; each detector is owned by ControlPlane and receives now as a parameter.

zero_trust_authz: Every command presentation must carry Principal, an affine Capability<K>, Action, ScopeKey, and now. Authorizer::evaluate rejects tenant mismatch, scope mismatch, missing grant, expired grant, missing policy, and disallowed action. Authorizer::authorize consumes the capability only after Decision::Allow and returns Granted<K>, which is the constructive proof of possession. The kernel uses unforgeable in-process affine tokens; the iroh adapter signs grants with iroh::SecretKey and verifies iroh::Signature before any lease, route, blob, or spawn effect. AGENTS.md rules are preserved: SigV4 is verified by the emulator core, created credentials are minted through the credential store, and presigned URLs are produced by ctx.url_signer() rather than by hand-written signatures. No secret appears in Command, WorkloadSpec, ProtocolStep, Snapshot, or Response. No ambient role, process-wide credential, or implicit trust boundary is used.
